headline: The Phoenix Mills Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition - The Phoenix Mills Limited has informed the Exchange about approval of reduction of equity share capital of Island Star Mall Developers Private Limited, subsidiary of the Company by NCLT Mumbai bench.
